meta.name: Oil / Gas OCF + Dividend + Low Vol Cycle Probe V5.8a
meta.objective: Test whether oil/gas candidates have preliminary OCF, dividend and low-volatility evidence after adding cycle-state proxy data and PIT industry-exposure tags.

universe.name: A-share oil/gas upstream, integrated, refining, natural-gas processing and distribution candidates
universe.construction: JoinQuant PIT industry membership: HY01103, HY01104, HY01105 and HY01106. HY01102 oilfield services are excluded from the first pass.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT financial fields + V5.8a futures-proxy external state + JQ industry-exposure proxy
data.external_state_policy: preliminary futures proxies only; allowed for Test-1 research validation, not formal promotion
data.business_exposure_policy: PIT JoinQuant industry membership proxy only; annual-report segment review is still required

price_adjustment.low_vol_panel: raw daily close history strictly before trade_date

data.source_warning: V5.8a is a data-gate repair and preliminary Quant probe. It must not be promoted without official spot/spread/tariff and annual-report exposure evidence.

factors.name: operating_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: Operating cash flow divided by market capitalization.

factors.name: low_vol_score
factors.source: daily close returns strictly before trade_date
factors.definition: Composite of negative realized volatility, downside volatility and max drawdown.

factors.name: dividend_yield
factors.definition: Visible dividend yield from valuation table.

factors.name: low_price_to_book
factors.definition: Lower PB is preferred if not explained by impaired or non-core assets.

factors.name: pe_ratio
factors.definition: Lower PE is preferred, but cyclical earnings distortion must be reviewed.

factors.name: capex_burden
factors.definition: Cash paid for fixed / intangible assets divided by operating cash flow.

factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: Operating cash flow minus capex, divided by market capitalization.

scoring.value_trap_guard: No hard oil/gas value-trap guard is approved in V5.8a. Capex burden and FCF are diagnostics until capex-cycle evidence is reviewed.

schedule.rebalance_rule: first tradable day of quarter after PIT visibility check

portfolio.cash_policy: hold residual cash when fewer than eight names pass filters

defensive_rule.reason: V5.8a is a research PIT probe, not a timing model.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: V5.8a may only decide whether oil/gas deserves deeper source repair. Historical return alone is insufficient and this probe cannot become an accepted strategy.
